additional_info.subject: RE: ID0453645-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / R8 170002501] emergency stop fault CRM:03056000101
additional_info.body:
Dear colleagues,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0453645.
The ticket was opened by Mr. Ferreira for continuous activation of error flag "
EmergencyStopButton_SF2
", while the emergency stop button is bypassed.
I had a quick look on AWS, and I can confirm that this error flag happened several times between 01.10.2025 and 03.10.2025. I believe it is necessary to go onsite and troubleshoot the error. It is necessary to check:
if the emergency trip line has any false contact is present (especially in connectors XD9.1A/B and XD9.2A/B)
if the QA26 is functioning and correctly receiving all signals
if the bypass on the emergency stop button is properly done
if the enable signal is arriving to the state monitor
if FC15 is producing 24V, hence if XD3 has voltage and so the EcoGs
Therefore, I am moving this ticket
ID0453645
form the Technical Support Team to the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue
for onsite visit and onsite troubleshooting.
Please let me know in advance if you need remote support for the visit.
Looking forward to hearing from you soon!
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
eMobility Customer Service
Technical Support Engineer
SI E EU CS TS
Nonnendammallee 101
13629 Berlin, Germany
mailto:fosco.servidei@siemens.com
www.siemens.com
Important notice: This e-mail and any attachment thereof contain corporate proprietary information. If you have received it by mistake, please notify us immediately by reply e-mail and delete this e-mail and its attachments from your system.
Thank you.
